column1: # Danish diacritic-fold table (D-436) - base letter -> every real variant, so a token typed without it
# ("ar") still reaches the correctly-spelled word ("år"/"ær"), both live while typing and at autocorrect/
# split-repair time. æ/ø/å are their own additional letters in the Danish alphabet (not merely accented
# a/o), but the same base-letter-fold mechanism still applies for typing convenience.
